title: School Band Story
subtitle: Grow a band. Hear the change.
promotionalText: Start with five beginners. Choose their practice, hear their progress, and guide your school band from its first rehearsal to the concert stage.
description:
Five first-year students walk into an empty music room. Your school band begins here.

In School Band Story, you guide a Japanese high school wind band through practice, performances and graduation. The music changes as your players improve: uncertain tuning, uneven rhythm and hesitant tone gradually become a sound you can be proud of.

HEAR EVERY PLAYER
The band plays using recorded instrument sounds, with each member's skills shaping the performance. Listen to the whole ensemble, one section or a single player. Compare an early recording with today's sound and hear how far they have come.

BUILD YOUR BAND
Choose weekly practice for each member, balance fundamentals with rehearsals, and give tired players time to rest. Every new piece takes time to learn. A growing reputation brings more students to your door, filling up to 39 seats.

MAKE THE LINEUP
Listen before auditions and choose who will take the stage. Stable players add depth to the sound; an unsteady performance can affect the whole ensemble.

TAKE THE PODIUM
Let the band perform on its own, or tap the beat to conduct. Where you tap controls the volume, and the players follow your tempo. Their preparation still matters.

A SCHOOL YEAR OF STORIES
Welcome new members, prepare for summer competitions, play at the school festival and send older students off at graduation. Assistant advisor Ms. Asano helps you find your next step.

KEEP THE MEMORIES
Save and share performance audio, then return to the recordings as your band grows.

15 CLASSICAL PIECES
Play wind-band arrangements including Can-Can, Pomp and Circumstance, Ode to Joy, Jupiter, Pachelbel's Canon and Spring from The Four Seasons.

Play offline. No ads, in-app purchases or account registration. Switch between Japanese and English in the Journal settings.

Instrument samples: VSCO 2 Community Edition, VCSL and Bear Sax (CC0); Weresax (CC BY 3.0); and University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples. Full credits are included in the app.
